subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Mrs. Lin says people and fruit are sometimes judged too quickly by appearance.”?
options: Sometimes it is a sign that people care about different parts of the same story.
It was about how society decides what is rare in a world of easy copies.
A mark on the outside does not always tell the truth about what is inside.
It was also about understanding effort, difficulty, and the people who made the week easier.
